$comment: Frozen cross-package classification table for inline sections. See stories/test-script-sections-contract.md section 5. Consumed by runner-core (classifyLines / extractSteps / extractSections / buildSectionIndex), by the root vitest suite for the hand-mirrored server-side scanner in src/parser/markdown.ts, and by the native + monaco copy-parity tests. BLANK LINES ARE OMITTED deliberately: trailing-newline and CRLF variance across checkouts makes a dense array fragile, while a misclassified non-blank line still shows up as a mismatch.

classification.md.note: The mainstream case: parses cleanly end-to-end and is the frozen extractSections / main-flow reference. The depth-4 heading at line 27 opens an IGNORED REGION (contract §5 rule 4a): it still does not close the Login section, but line 29 under it is inert — it is not a body step, not a main-flow step, and nothing runs it. Contrast the bare #### in classification-hashes.md, which opens an empty-name section and so does close a body. `### Cleanup` is deliberately never invoked, so this file doubles as the dead-section-warning fixture: expanding it must emit exactly one warning, naming Cleanup.

classification-edge.md.note: Raw-scan vs marked-token behaviour. Line 16 (`4.`) matches neither scanner (no content after the dot) and is absent from both. Line 17 (`5. [no-hooks]`) is marker-only: classifyLines still reports section-step (the editor paints what looks like a step, as it does today for main-flow marker-only lines) but BOTH the CLI parser and extractSections CULL it per contract 3.1 — hence its absence from expectedSections. Line 15 is a NO-divergence control: the marker regex is anchored so `**[no-hooks]**` is not stripped by the raw scan, AND extractPlainText is the identity in a tight list, so both passes agree byte for byte. Line 20 (numbered line inside a fenced block) is the SOLE genuine divergence — invisible to marked, a step to the raw scan — so this sectioned file must throw the CLI equal-lengths assert rather than warn-and-trim.

steps.instruction: **[no-hooks]** Bold marker is not stripped by the marker regex
Numbered line inside a fenced block

classification-edge.md.expectsCliParseError: equal-lengths assert: the fenced numbered line at 20 is a step to the raw scan and invisible to marked

classification-hashes.md.note: Hashes-only headings at depths 3, 4 and 7. All classify as section-heading with an EMPTY name — ANY_HEADING_RE cannot see them (it demands a non-space after the hashes), so without the dedicated rule they would be prose and Steptix would run the bodies as main-flow steps while the CLI errored. Per contract 5 each hashes-only line both closes the preceding body and opens a new section, so this file yields THREE single-step empty-name sections, not one merged section. Empty names never enter SectionIndex.sections; all three land in duplicates under the empty-string key. The CLI must reject this file (empty section name).
